display.title: Ready for Moshiach: Jewish Children Will Lead the Parade
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi tells children that they will be the first to greet Moshiach, proud of the rank they earned in Tzivos Hashem, and will ride heavenly clouds to Eretz Yisroel.
display.summary_long: A short, upbeat talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that it is a great merit to be a soldier in Hashem's army, because Moshiach is about to come and the first to welcome him will be the young Jewish schoolchildren, marching at the head of the parade out of golus. Children will be able to tell Moshiach how impatiently they waited for him, how proudly they learn Torah and do mitzvos with joy, and how they rose from private to a higher rank, perhaps even general, with points from their mitzvah charts and mission cards. Quoting the prophet Daniel, he describes the heavenly clouds that Hashem will lower so that everyone can step in and be carried to Eretz Yisroel.
display.lesson: Get ready to greet Moshiach by learning Torah and doing mitzvos with joy.

date.note: Cut from episode 384 (07-04-89). The same talk also aired in episodes 280 and 439.
